description: This source file implements utility functions for QUIC protocol handling within the 'quic' namespace, including version support, configuration, mode-to-string conversion, and Linux-specific TUN interface creation.

methods.name: MasqueSupportedVersions
methods.description: Returns a vector of supported QUIC versions that support IETF draft, excluding QUICv2.

methods.name: MasqueEncapsulatedConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a QUIC configuration with maximum packet size set for encapsulated packets.

methods.name: MasqueModeToString
methods.description: Converts a MasqueMode enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(std::ostream&, const MasqueMode&)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a MasqueMode to an output stream.

methods.name: CreateTunInterface
methods.description: Creates a TUN interface on Linux systems with specific network configurations based on the client address and server flag.
